requirements.text: Students should be able to manage their loans online, including viewing checked-out items, due dates, and fine history.
There should be a way to handle exceptions for overdue items and fines with personal oversight.
The system should allow students to book study rooms, showing availability and allowing them to choose specific times and numbers of users.
Manage bookings to prevent conflicts and double reservations.
There should be a clear process for handling study room bookings to address any questions or issues that students might have.
Librarians should have access to reports on loans, popular items, and study room usage to inform decision-making.
The system should maintain personal interactions with patrons to address nuances that reports may overlook.
